title: SilentSuite self-host server image manifest
description: Immutable identity of the server image a self-host release installs. Written by the tag release workflow and verified by the installer before any operator state is touched.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bump only for an incompatible field change.

tag.description: Immutable umbrella release tag this bundle belongs to.

sourceCommit.description: Exact commit the tag resolves to, proven reachable from protected main.

imageRepository.description: Canonical image repository. Runtime selection is always by index digest.

indexDigest.description: OCI index digest operators pin in SILENTSUITE_SERVER_IMAGE.

amd64Digest.description: linux/amd64 child manifest digest inside the index.

arm64Digest.description: linux/arm64 child manifest digest inside the index.

platforms.description: Closed set of runnable platforms the index is verified to provide.

expectedRevision.description: org.opencontainers.image.revision label every child must carry.
